problem_statement: Build a brand-new Contact page from scratch at the /contact route of this Material Tailwind dashboard. The route does not exist yet — today it falls through to the dashboard home. Construct the full static page inside the site's existing dashboard shell (left sidebar + top navbar + footer) and reuse the Material Tailwind design system (Card, CardHeader variant=gradient color=gray, Typography h3/h5, Button, the blue-gray color tokens plus Heroicons). The page helps a visitor get in touch: a gradient hero, a 'Ways to Reach Us' grid of contact channels, an 'Our Offices' grid of locations, a 'Support Hours' callout, a 'Follow Us' set of social links, and a closing call-to-action card. It is a static informational page — no interactive controls — and must render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: A gradient hero card header titled 'Contact Nexus Analytics' with a short tagline, styled like the other dashboard card headers
An intro paragraph under the hero explaining that the team is happy to help
A 'Ways to Reach Us' section presenting three contact-channel cards (email, phone/support call, live chat), each with an icon, the contact detail and a short description
An 'Our Offices' section with a grid of three office cards (San Francisco, Berlin, Singapore), each with a map-pin icon, a city name and a street address
A 'Support Hours' section with a heading and a card describing when the support team is online
A 'Follow Us' section listing the company's social links (Twitter/X, LinkedIn, GitHub)
A closing call-to-action card with a 'Book a demo' button
The whole page sits inside the dashboard shell (left sidebar nav + top navbar + footer), consistent with the existing pages
design_constraints: Reuse Material Tailwind components already used by the dashboard (Card, CardHeader variant=gradient color=gray, CardBody, Typography, Button) plus Heroicons for the channel/office icons
Keep the site's blue-gray color palette and spacing; do not introduce a new visual language
Mount the page inside the existing dashboard layout chrome (Sidenav, DashboardNavbar, Footer)
Static informational page — no interactive controls or state
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /contact 是空 route (element={<></>}), 不走 catch-all 重定向; reference 从零实现完整 Contact 页; bad 在 reference 基础上删掉必需的 'Our Offices' section (h3 'Our Offices' 不再出现), 只失 dom_assertions + completion_text_signals 门。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。route 顶层挂载, 无 basename/vite base, 故 state_plan path 为 /contact。T1: 纯静态页, 无交互, dom_assertions only.
